name: Blessed Warrior (Sphere Archetype)
body:
The following archetype is designed for use with the Spheres of Power, Spheres of Might, and Spheres of Guile alternate rules. If not using Spheres, disregard these archetypes!

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A blessed warrior is proficient with all simple weapons, and with light armor and bucklers. In addition, if this is the character’s first level in any class, they may select a martial tradition of their choice. This alters weapon and armor proficiencies.

Combat Training (Ex)

A blessed warrior is considered an Adept practitioner, gaining spheres and talents as appropriate. A blessed warrior uses their casting ability modifier as their practitioner modifier. This replaces the blessings received at 3rd, 5th, 9th, 11th, 15th, and 17th level.
